articles.title: Local government elections as a litmus test of Armenia`s electoral crisis
articles.description: Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan, who has been portraying himself as a "defender of the oppressed" facing pressure during local government elections since yesterday evening, after several lengthy posts on his social media accounts on this topic, dropped his mask of virtue and began threatening a family member of an opposition candidate with dismissal.

articles.title: The Catholicos of All Armenians received the clergy of the Trieste Diocese of the Catholic Church

articles.description: The Ministry of Education, Science, Culture, and Sports (MESC) of Armenia and Ghent University signed a memorandum of understanding online.

articles.description: At the initiative and with the personal participation of Kajaran Mayor Manvel Paramazyan, a khachkar commemorating the victims of the Armenian Genocide was erected in the courtyard of the Armenian Catholic Church of St. Gregory of Narek in the French town of Saint-Chamond.

articles.title: In Armenia, periodic rain and thunderstorms are expected from October 20 to 25
articles.description: Rain and thunderstorms are expected in Armenia from October 20th to 25th.

articles.title: Artsakh residents handed over a letter to the embassies of three European countries calling for the issue of their forced displacement to be raised at COP17.
articles.description: Against the backdrop of the 17th Conference of the Parties to the UN Convention on Biological Diversity (COP17) being held in Yerevan, Artsakh residents handed over letters to the embassies of three European countries, calling for the issue of forced displacement of the Artsakh population, the preservation of its cultural heritage, and the protection of the natural environment to be raised.

articles.title: The Ministry of Labor proposes extending the cashback program for pension and benefit recipients until the end of 2029
articles.description: The Armenian Ministry of Labor and Welfare proposes extending the 20% cashback program on non-cash purchases made using bank cards to which pensions and benefits are transferred until the end of 2029.

articles.title: The impact of AI on biodiversity was discussed in Yerevan at COP17
articles.description: An international discussion on the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on biodiversity was held in Yerevan.

articles.title: Pashinyan called for reporting cases of pressure on election participants to the local self-government bodies – but is everything so simple
articles.description: Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan called on all candidates and voters participating in local government elections who claim they have been subjected to illegal pressure to report such cases to him personally.

articles.title: Suren Papikyan left for the Czech Republic on an official visit
articles.description: A delegation led by Armenian Defense Minister Suren Papikyan has departed for the Czech Republic on an official visit.

articles.title: The Office of the EU Special Representative for the South Caucasus responded to the Hayakve protest in connection with Grono`s visit to occupied Artsakh.
articles.description: The Office of the EU Special Representative for the South Caucasus and the Crisis in Georgia, Magdalena Grono, responded to an appeal from the organization "Hayakve" regarding the official's visit to occupied Artsakh as part of a tour organized by Azerbaijan on September 11-12.

articles.title: More than four dozen NGOs in Armenia issued a statement condemning the start of development of the Amulsar mine
articles.description: More than four dozen Armenian non-governmental organizations issued a joint statement against the backdrop of the 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (COP17) taking place in Yerevan, condemning the start of development of the Amulsar mine.

articles.title: Meeting of the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan with the US Secretary of State
articles.description: On October 19, 2026, a meeting was held in Samarkand between Rashid Meredov, Minister of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan, and Marco Rubio, Secretary of State of the United States of America.

articles.title: Idram and IDBank Participated in the Opening of My Forest Armenia’s Pavilion at COP17
articles.description: The opening of the “Forest Biodiversity: An Immersive Experience” exhibition by the “My Forest Armenia” NGO took place in the Green Zone of COP17, with representatives of IDBank and Idram in attendance.

articles.title: The Armenian Foreign Ministry discussed the UN WFP Strategic Plan for Armenia for 2026-2030.
articles.description: On the sidelines of the 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (COP19) in Yerevan, Armenian Deputy Foreign Minister Robert Abisogomonyan met with Matthew Hollingworth, Deputy Executive Director for Operational Programs at the UN World Food Programme (WFP).

articles.title: Take care of nature with Team: the company is launching an environmental campaign as part of COP17.
articles.description: Team Telecom Armenia, a technology partner of COP17, announced the launch of an environmental campaign on October 19 under the slogan "Caring with Action." According to Team's press service, the campaign aims to develop the habit of caring for nature on a daily basis.

articles.title: The Prime Minister discussed the progress of the Academic City program.
articles.description: A meeting chaired by Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan was held to discuss the progress of the "Academic City" program. Minister of Education, Science, Culture, and Sports Zhanna Andreasyan presented a report on the program's current and completed work. Specifically, the project's infrastructure and content were discussed.

articles.title: Armenia`s Minister of Environment has been elected as COP17 President for a two-year term.
articles.description: Environment Minister Amburtsum Matevosyan has been elected President of COP17 for a two-year term. This was reported by the press service of the Ministry of Environment, citing the results of the plenary session at the opening of the Conference of the Parties to the UN Convention on Biological Diversity (COP17).

articles.title: Tigran Abrahamyan: The Strong Armenia faction has introduced a bill aimed at reducing the cost of medicines in the country.
articles.description: The Strong Armenia faction has initiated amendments to the law "On Medicines," providing for simplified registration of European drugs and a 20% reduction in their prices. This was announced by Tigran Abrahamyan, secretary of the Strong Armenia faction, in a video published on his Facebook page.

articles.title: The President of Armenia made personnel appointments to the country`s Ministry of Defense.
articles.description: By decree of Armenian President Vahagn Khachaturyan, Norayr Mkrtchyan has been appointed head of the Moral and Psychological Support Department of the Armed Forces. The decree on the appointment was published on the head of state's website.

articles.title: National heroes Tatul Ghazaryan and Armen Ohanyan were commemorated in Tavush
articles.description: Tavush honored the memory of national heroes Tatul Ghazaryan and Armen Ohanyan, who died during the 44-day war of 2020.

articles.title: "Save Amulsar": A protest against the exploitation of the Amulsar gold mine took place in Yerevan during COP17
articles.description: A protest against the exploitation of the Amulsar gold mine took place near the Karen Demirchyan Sports and Concert Complex, where the 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (COP17) is taking place. Police prevented demonstrators from entering the complex, forming a circle around the stairs.

articles.title: Armenia and WFP representative agreed to conduct joint exercises and capacity development
articles.description: During a joint meeting, Armenian Interior Minister Arpine Sargsyan and the UN World Food Programme (WFP) representative Matthew Hollingworth agreed to expand cooperation in the areas of joint exercises and capacity development.

articles.title: Expert on protests in France: Civilizations fade when society loses a vision of the future
articles.description: What's happening in France is being characterized as a "crisis of hope," the causes of which are multifaceted: from economic problems to a crisis of youth expectations for the future. This was written on Facebook by orientalist and Arabist Gor Gevorgyan, responding to the mass protests and unrest taking place in France.

articles.title: The State Protocol Service will have a new chief
articles.description: Gagik Vanoyan has been relieved of his post as Head of the State Protocol Service. The corresponding decision was signed by Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan on October 19.

articles.title: The Head of the Office of the Chief Commissioner for Diaspora Affairs discussed prospects for developing bilateral cooperation with a Polish senator
articles.description: High Commissioner for Diaspora Affairs Zareh Sinanyan discussed with Senator Bogdan Borusewicz, Chairman of the Polish Senate Committee on Emigration and Relations with Poles Abroad, opportunities for developing cooperation between the Office of the High Commissioner for Diaspora Affairs of the Republic of Armenia and the relevant committee of the Polish Senate, exchanging experiences, and implementing joint initiatives.

articles.title: Turkologist: Azerbaijan is not all-powerful—its vulnerabilities should become part of Armenia’s security strategy

articles.title: Prime Minister: Armenia is halfway to achieving the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework targets
articles.description: The international community has already formulated the concept of "living in harmony with nature" and, in 2022, adopted the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, setting goals and clear benchmarks until 2030. Armenia, however, is halfway to achieving these benchmarks. This was stated by Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan at the opening plenary session of the "Leaders for Nature" summit, held as part of COP17 (the 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity) at the Meridian Expo Center.

articles.title: Gagik Tsarukyan from the NSS detention center called for the release of Armenians held captive in Baku
articles.description: Even under conditions of colossal psychological pressure and complete isolation, Armenian prisoners of war held in a Baku prison are behaving with incredible dignity. This is stated in a message from Prosperous Armenia Party (PAP) leader Gagik Tsarukyan from the Yerevan Kentron prison (better known as the NSS basements).

articles.title: Armenia extradited a man accused of causing bodily harm to Germany
articles.description: Armenian Prosecutor General Anna Vardapetyan granted the request of the competent German authority, resulting in the transfer of the wanted individual, L. Ch., to German authorities. The press service of the Prosecutor General's Office of Armenia reported this to ArmInfo.

articles.title: A memorial plaque in memory of Levon Hayrapetyan was unveiled at 31 Moskovyan Street in Yerevan.
articles.description: A memorial plaque in memory of philanthropist and entrepreneur Levon Hayrapetyan was unveiled at 31 Moskovyan Street in Yerevan.

articles.title: A delegation led by the Vice Mayor of Beijing visited Yerevan Lake
articles.description: A delegation led by Beijing Vice Mayor Wen Xiang, visiting the Armenian capital for COP17, visited Yerevan Lake.

articles.title: Father Asoghik criticized the Armenian authorities for ignoring the interests of the Armenian Church in their interactions with UNESCO
articles.description: Father Asoghik Karapetyan, a member of the National Commission for UNESCO in Armenia, criticized the Armenian authorities for ignoring the interests of the Armenian Apostolic Church in their interactions with UNESCO.

articles.title: Armenia supported the early entry into force of the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty
articles.description: Armenia supported the early entry into force of the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty. This was reported by the press service of the Permanent Mission of Armenia to the UN.

articles.title: "Strong Armenia": Samvel Karapetyan will repair Kirk Kerkorian Street in Gyumri at his own expense.
articles.description: Strong Armenia bloc leader Samvel Karapetyan will ensure the improvement of Kirk Kerkoryan Street in Gyumri in line with international standards. Narek Karapetyan, head of the Strong Armenia parliamentary faction, announced this during the Gyumri City Day celebrations.

articles.title: Gagik Baghunts called on COP17 participants to take into account the traditional knowledge and experience of Armenians displaced from Artsakh as the indigenous population of the region.
articles.description: While emphasizing the importance of preserving biological diversity, sustainable use of natural resources and effective public participation in environmental decision-making, the authorities of Artsakh express deep concern over the environmental and biocultural consequences of the forced displacement of the Armenian population of Artsakh. This was stated in the message of Acting Speaker of the National Assembly of Artsakh Gagik Baghunts to the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity, delegates, and participants of the CBD COP17 conference.

articles.title: The Ombudsmen of Armenia and Australia discussed the activities of the national human rights institutions of the two countries
articles.description: The Human Rights Defender of Armenia, Anahit Manasyan, who is on a working visit to Australia, discussed with her Australian counterpart, Hugh de Kretser, issues related to the activities of national human rights institutions, guarantees for their independence and effective operation, as well as challenges in the field of human rights protection.

articles.title: The Artsakh Public Council expressed outrage at the UN Secretary-General`s behavior
articles.description: The Public Council of the Republic of Artsakh expresses deep concern and outrage over the statements made by UN Secretary-General António Guterres at COP17 in Armenia. While speaking about the rights of indigenous peoples, biodiversity conservation, and the responsibility of the international community, he failed to mention the forced displacement of the indigenous Armenian population of Artsakh and their right to return to their homeland.

articles.title: The Armenian Ambassador to the United States held an official dinner with representatives of diplomatic, public and business circles
articles.description: Armenian Ambassador to the United States Narek Mkrtchyan hosted an official dinner with representatives of diplomatic, public, and business circles.

articles.title: Ashgabat Proposes Establishing the Regional Center to Combat Desertification
articles.description: On October 16, during his address at the Leaders’ Summit of the UN Biodiversity Conference in Yerevan, President of Turkmenistan Serdar Berdimuhamedov proposed establishing the Regional Center to Combat Desertification for the countries of Central Asia.

articles.title: Placido Domingo was the guest of honor at the gala concert in honor of Gegham Grigoryan
articles.description: To commemorate the 75th anniversary of the legendary tenor of world opera Gegham Grigoryan, a concert was held at the National Academic Opera and Ballet Theater named after A gala concert was held at the A. Spendiaryan National Opera and Ballet Theatre, featuring opera star, Spanish tenor, pianist, and conductor Placido Domingo as a special guest.

articles.title: UNESCO Director-General Khaled El-Enany visited the Zvartnots Cathedral
articles.description: UNESCO Director-General Khaled El-Enany, who is in Armenia to participate in the 17th Conference of the Parties (COP17) to the Convention on Biological Diversity, visited the Zvartnots Cathedral, inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

articles.title: The ARF Student Union criticized the Armenian authorities` intention to initiate an exchange program between Armenian and Turkish students
articles.description: The Armenian authorities' intention to initiate an exchange program between Armenian and Turkish students raises serious concerns, according to a statement from the ARF student union "Nikol Aghbalyan."

articles.title: Armenia and Kyrgyzstan called for further deepening of bilateral relations
articles.description: Armenia and Kyrgyzstan have all the prerequisites to give new substance to relations between the two countries and translate the existing potential for cooperation into practical results. This was stated by Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan following talks with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov during a joint press statement.

articles.title: Nikol Pashinyan and Sadyr Japarov held talks in Yerevan
articles.description: Talks were held in Yerevan between Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan and a delegation led by Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, who is on an official visit to Armenia.

articles.title: Yerevan and Bishkek became sister cities
articles.description: Yerevan and Bishkek have become sister cities. Yerevan Mayor Tigran Avinyan announced this on his Facebook page.

articles.title: Leonardo DiCaprio expressed support for a large-scale global initiative to protect endangered species, announced in Yerevan
articles.description: Hollywood actor and environmentalist Leonardo DiCaprio expressed support for a large-scale global initiative to protect endangered species, announced in Yerevan during the COP17 biodiversity conference.

articles.title: The final games of the Roman Berezovsky Prize tournament have begun in the Armavir region
articles.description: The final games of the Roman Berezovsky Prize tournament kicked off at the Sardarapat FC stadium in Armenia's Armavir region, bringing together 11 school teams from ten regions of Armenia and Yerevan.

articles.title: Happy holiday, city with soul and character - Russian House in Gyumri
articles.description: Happy City Day, a city with soul and character. This is the message from the Russian House in Gyumri on the occasion of the Second Day of the Armenian city's greatness.

articles.title: Armenia and UNESCO agreed to continue deepening bilateral cooperation
articles.description: At a meeting with UNESCO Director-General Khaled El-Enany, Armenian Minister of Education, Science, Culture, and Sport Zhanna Andreasyan praised the effective cooperation established with UNESCO in the fields of education, science, culture, information, and communication, reaffirming Armenia's readiness to continue and expand joint initiatives. The UNESCO Director-General visited Armenia to participate in the 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (COP17).

articles.title: "Strong Armenia" congratulated Gyumri on City Day
articles.description: The Strong Armenia Party congratulated Gyumri on City Day.

articles.title: The Secretary General of the Armenian Ministry of Defense discussed strengthening integrity in the defense sector with a NATO representative
articles.description: Hamlet Batikyan, Secretary General of the Armenian Ministry of Defense, and Piers Cazalet, Director of NATO's Directorate for Defense and Security Cooperation, discussed cooperation aimed at strengthening integrity in the defense sector at a meeting at NATO Headquarters in Brussels.

articles.title: Lawyer: House arrest of Fatherland Party Secretary General extended for three months
articles.description: The house arrest of Fatherland Party Secretary General Khachik Galstyan has been extended for three months. This was announced on his Facebook page by lawyer Arsen Babayan, who published a message from Galstyan from house arrest.

articles.title: Kopyrkin: Relations between Russia and Armenia are going through a phase that requires mutual understanding and a search for a new balance.
articles.description: Relations between Russia and Armenia are going through a phase that requires mutual understanding and a search for a new balance. This was stated by Russian Ambassador to Armenia Sergey Kopyrkin on October 16 at a ceremony dedicated to the 70th anniversary of the Marshal Baghramyan Association of Veterans of the Republic of Armenia.

articles.title: Armenia`s Minister of Environment discussed the COP17 agenda with his colleagues from China and Oman.
articles.description: Armenian Environment Minister Hambardzum Matevosyan met with Chinese Minister of Ecology and Environment Huang Runqiu and Abdullah Ali, Chairman of the Environment Protection Authority of the Sultanate of Oman, ahead of the 17th Conference of the Parties to the UN Convention on Biological Diversity (COP17).

articles.title: Human rights activist: The Armenian government confirms that it has approached third countries regarding visits to Armenian prisoners of war, but denies receiving their consent.
articles.description: The Republic of Armenia confirms that it has approached third countries with a request to organize a consular visit to Armenian prisoners of war, but denies that these countries have given their consent. Siranush Sahakyan, a lawyer representing Armenian prisoners of war at the European Court of Human Rights (ECHR), announced this at a press conference in Yerevan on October 16.

articles.title: Kyrgyzstan is interested in adapting the Armenian educational model in its country.
articles.description: Kyrgyzstan is interested in adapting the Armenian educational model in its country. According to the press service of the Ministry of Education, Science, Culture, and Sports (MESCS), this was announced during a meeting between MESCS head Zhanna Andreasyan and Kyrgyz representatives – Minister of Science, Higher Education, and Innovation Gulzat Isamatova and Minister of Education Dogdurkul Kendyrbayeva.

articles.title: Human rights activist: Torture of Armenian prisoners of war in Azerbaijan is endemic
articles.description: In a report submitted to the Armenian side, the UN-sponsored Committee characterizes torture of Armenian prisoners of war held in Baku not so much as a systematic phenomenon, but rather as an endemic process. Siranush Sahakyan, a lawyer representing Armenian prisoners of war at the European Court of Human Rights (ECHR), announced this at a press conference in Yerevan on October 16.

articles.title: The Armenian Prime Minister held meetings with the Director-General of UNESCO and the Vice-President of the European Commission.
articles.description: Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan held separate meetings with UNESCO Director-General Khaled Al-Anani and European Commission Vice-President Teresa Ribera on the sidelines of COP17.
